title: phyllanthus squamifolius
intro: Phyllanthus squamifolius, commonly known as the "Pata de Vaca," is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. It is known for its various health benefits, including its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Pata de Vaca include treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as having hepatoprotective and anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
